title: A C_c cut-off on ℝ^N × G(N,n) sandwiching closed-ball cylinder masses
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, G := Grassmannian N n (SimonGMT's projection-matrix Grassmannian), and for r ∈ ℝ let K_r := closedBall (0 : ℝ^N) r ×ˢ univ ⊆ ℝ^N × G. For all real a < b there is a single F ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G, ℝ), chosen before the measure, such that every measure ν on ℝ^N × G with ν(K_b) ≠ ∞ satisfies ν(K_a) ≤ ofReal(∫ F dν) and ofReal(∫ F dν) ≤ ν(K_b). (∫ is the Bochner integral, which is 0 for non-integrable integrands, as in Lean.)
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∃ F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), ∀ ν : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), ν (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≠ ∞ → ν (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) a ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z, F z ∂ν) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z, F z ∂ν) ≤ ν (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))
